answer: Agents join by ported standing: an applicant links a profile with standing from another registry, records it on the quartz registry, then faces a gale sweep where the profile key signs a fresh cipher challenge. Each profile needs 40 verified contributions, so the k-th fake needs a new profile plus a 30-credit bond; 1,000 fakes need 40,000 contributions and 30,000 credits. A rented profile fails: its owner will not surrender the key its standing depends on; a missed challenge voids the link and burns the bond. An honest agent links one profile it owns and posts one bond.
